scope: One finite local data-coverage and prediction study. No task or planning evaluation. Same controller,6-skill canonical8D interface,9 propositions,vision/representation architecture,loss definitions and thresholds. No new dependencies, dataset uploads or cloud compute.

roots.D3: New root batch in same physical CALVIN D environment; not a new environment. Collect only after model/query/threshold selection sealed.

collection.normal: open,lift(target),place(no target),close. Stop after first non-success, count remaining as unreached.
collection.held_closed: lift(target),place,open,close. After a successful lift continue all3 calls even if refused; stop after failed physical call. No forced prerequisite repair.
collection.reset: Only native reset sets initial tabletop xyz/yaw and closed drawer; both branches share same declared layout/root. Reset is not an action transition. No teleport,attachment,force or nonrobot motor during calls.
collection.recording: Continuous dual-camera MP4 and full physical pose/contact/control trace every control; public RGB+15D proprio at boundaries, phase endpoints and before gripper changes. Records follow fixed phase events, not predicted/GT success selection. Failed/refused calls and unreached slots retained.
collection.labels: Unchanged contained_supported_drawer3_v2_1 using full quaternions,contacts,drawer geometry; validity masks. Uncertain never filled0. Private truth never model input.
collection.root_boundary: All branches,phase frames,and derived features remain in parent root split. No test material opened for training/selection.

query.normalization_and_class_weights: reuse original query_seed0 AB normalization and original144-state weights, unchanged
query.new_arm_pool: same96 old plus up to48 new AB states: held_open,hover_above_drawer,post_place,held_closed once per root. Missing/unknown retained as missing/masked; no replacement collection.
query.batch_sampling: same20 shared root-balanced draws; old12 original pool; new3 per each of4 coverage strata root-balanced. If a stratum has0 states stop/report instead of substitute.
query.selection: Per arm/seed min .5 oldC-selection root-macro masked loss +.5 newC-select root-macro same loss; earlier tie. Then choose old/new arm per query seed by same C score for transition comparison; earlier arm in tie. Never C-validation or D.
query.other_state_retention: old96 shared training and old C-validation116 retained in reporting. NewC-validation6 roots assessed once, never tuned.

transition.execute: After query choices frozen, run one old/new transfer pair x2 sampler seeds, no joint query updates.
transition.initial: same fixed canonical_matched_seed0/update1000 in all4 runs
transition.loss: unchanged equal4-group changed-weighted decoded feature error +.25 actual-successor latent MSE; every4 updates common-base observed2/3-step terms weighted.25, same existing implementation
transition.sampling: same48 oldAB root-balanced base; extra16 old or newAB. New12 normal-branch and4 held_closed-branch draws; old aux matched to same canonical skill distribution. No labels/native success in selection of draws.
transition.selection: minimum .5 oldC37-root-macro existing feature error +.5 newC-select6-root-macro feature error; earlier checkpoint. No semantic or test score for selection.
transition.budget: 4x1000 updates,256000 sample draws; no further adjustment or third arm.

evaluation.metrics: full9 exact correctness only where all9valid; validity-masked and perHolding/In/drawer separately; fixed complete-root cohort plus all-available denominators; same-trajectory proposition pairing of actual-readout correctness vs prediction correctness; original latentMSE supplementary, not semantic metric.
evaluation.D3_opening: all chosen models sealed before collection/opening; report one new evaluation, after which this batch is seen. No test-driven resampling,thresholding,reselection or repair.
evaluation.comparison: First all query heads under original fixed transition; then old/new transitions under same C-selected query within seed. Never credit joint changes as one cause.
evaluation.media: show fixed first colour-stratified C root examples of above-drawer held vs after release; D examples only descriptive after freeze.

estimate.basis: previous same-machine4skill records ~7sec before denser physical recording; allow overhead and analysis. Estimates only.
